content.text: Excellent! The Researcher Agent demonstrates sophisticated synthesis capabilities. Now let me test the Programmer Agent with a complex coding challenge:

input.task: Design and implement a Python class system for a self-modifying AI agent architecture. The system should include: (1) A base Agent class with dynamic capability registration, (2) A CommunicationBus for inter-agent messaging, (3) A MemorySystem with both short-term and long-term storage, (4) An AdaptivePlanner that can modify its own planning strategies, and (5) Integration points for external tools. Include comprehensive error handling, type hints, and documentation. This should be production-ready code demonstrating advanced software architecture patterns.
